notes.title: Major Update — Space Hub, Security, and UI Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]A New Way To Share XR Experiences[/h1][p][/p][p]Hey there![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for waiting patiently for new updates! This past Spring we've been working on some larger features to make even more possible with StellarX. This is just the beginning of what is to come this Summer.[/p][p]This brand new release brings major improvements for a more seamless and secure experience. The new Space Hub enables users to manage uploaded cloud spaces directly from the web portal. Multi-account management ensures that users only see the spaces they create or download. Controllers have also been redesigned for a more intuitive and user-friendly experience.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features 💫[/b][/h2][h3][b]Space Hub[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]*This feature is for uploaded spaces, uploading spaces in StellarX requires a Pro license.[/p][p]You can now manage your uploaded spaces directly from the Web Portal! The new Cloud Spaces tab is where you’ll find them.[/p][p]On the Space Hub, you can now:[/p][list][*][p]Remove an uploaded space from the cloud[/p][/*][*][p]Create the shared code[/p][/*][*][p]Delete the shared code (* Deleting the code removes the ability for other users to enter the space in play or create mode )[/p][/*][*][p]Copy the shared code[/p][/*][*][p]Sort Spaces by Name, Date Created, Last Updated and Size[/p][/*][/list][p]To see the spaces in your Cloud Spaces tab, upload the spaces through the information panel in the app of any of your spaces.[/p][p]Once you have clicked : Upload to cloud, the space will appear in the Cloud Spaces tab after a refresh.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/9b3d0d0bd54026326c129663f48814ff099233cd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Multi-Account Management[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]On shared devices, 'My Space' and 'Shared' environments from different users were previously visible across separate StellarX accounts. This has been fixed. We are introducing multi-account management.[/p][p]What’s Changing?[/p][list][*][p]Users will now only see the spaces they created or downloaded on the device[/p][/*][*][p]Space files stored in My Documents/StellarX/Saves will be transferred to backend folders.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/caad8aa59155b20b76975c97ce3def04cdf027d5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Important Notice[/b][/p][p]If you have previously saved space files for future use, ensure they are placed in the Saves folder before updating to avoid issues.[/p][p]If you’ve already updated and still have space files you need to use, please contact us directly at support@stellarx.ai.[/p][p]This change paves the way for future features, stay tuned for more to come![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Controllers[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The controllers have been redesigned for a more intuitive experience. Avatar hands have been removed and were replaced by Meta Quest controllers design.[/p][p]The buttons and joystick are now visible and will display animations showing what is being pressed, hovered over or moved.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Joystick and Triggers[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Virtual joystick will follow the user's movements of the physical joystick.[/p][p][/p][p][b]B and Y buttons[/b][/p][p]If users hover over the buttons, they will light up green.[/p][p]If users press the buttons, they will light up even more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Oculus Button[/b][/p][p]If the Oculus button is pressed it will light up green.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Anchor Teleport Point[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]After much testing, a new element has been added to help guide users to teleport to specific locations. This asset is especially helpful for new users or those who struggle with VR movements.[/p][p][/p][p]How Does It Work ?[/p][list][*][p]Open the UI collection of the Asset library[/p][/*][*][p]Place an Anchor Point Asset exactly where you want a user to teleport[/p][/*][*][p]Add a visual cue over of the Anchor Point, as this asset becomes invisible in Play mode ( Tip : Add the Teleport Point over )[/p][/*][/list][p]Result[/p][p]When users aim to teleport, they'll notice that as they get near an anchor point, the teleport arrow disappears and the cursor automatically centers to the anchor point, making the action feel guided and effortless.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Improvements 🌟[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]New Previews[/b][/h3][p]Previews now feature a refreshed visual style and an updated creation process. When the Save button is pressed, the preview will automatically capture what is in front of the user, making it easier to generate accurate and relevant thumbnails.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]UI Asset Teleport Access[/b][/h3][p]The ability to teleport on UI assets (such as Arrow, Teleport Point and Grab Icon) has been removed, as these assets do not have colliders and could never actually be teleported on. This change helps eliminate confusion around a feature that was non-functional for those assets.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/f5740a1fac644c7684dec7a8235478166113c797.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Custom Avatars[/b][/h3][p]In order to maintain player visibility, we've reintroduced our own custom avatars, allowing you to continue seeing other players in the multiplayer sessions. Meta Avatars have been removed as a result.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/ef822c9346adb6c21e33465301cd586e22169145.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bug fixes 🐞[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Downloading a space from a previous STX version provoked a black screen Avatar Recorder [/p][/*][*][p]Anchor point was visible when Show/Hide display was applied true in avatar recorder remix Media Panel - When cloning a media panel with media in the list, a prompt to save the space when returning to basecamp was missing Local Importation [/p][/*][*][p]Local imported media appeared many times in the library[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Release — Standardization of Assets
notes.notes:
Hello there, 👋🏻

With the winter season in full swing, we’re excited to share something special! This February, we’re rolling out a fresh update with improvements designed to enhance your experience. ❄️


[h2]New Features 💫[/h2]

[h3]Canvas access in Multiplayer Create Mode[/h3]

In Multiplayer Create Mode sessions, the Canvas can now be opened in View-Only mode, allowing users to explore the scenario's content and nodes, something previously unavailable.

This enhancement makes it easier to showcase scenario construction, highlight node usage, and suggest alternatives for better optimization. It also helps users understand the building process and debug their own scenarios.

Users no longer need to remove their space from the cloud to view scenarios. This simplifies collaboration, enabling two users to discuss and visualize a scenario together without taking it offline or relying on screen sharing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/2c83d6222e084ee92fd7b0b349e9136ea3476e1c.png[/img]

[h3]Performance Profiler Standalone Indicator[/h3]

On the Stellarx Steam version, the [url=https://help.ova.ai/hc/en-us/articles/28274672648212-Performance-Profiler]performance profiler[/url] geometry indicator now includes a dedicated section for Standalone geometry metrics. This enhancement provides clearer insights into Standalone performance limits, helping users optimize their spaces on Steam to ensure better compatibility if or when using the space on Standalone.


[b]New Two-Section Geometry indicator:[/b]
[list]
[*] The first section indicates the performance limit for Standalone, which is capped at 500K triangles. 
[*] The second section begins at the 500K separator and extends up to 5M  triangles, representing Steam’s performance limit.
[/list]
In both sections, the indicator shifts from purple to red at 75% to highlight potential performance concerns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/a2b03c1efcb61db913f8747ba4eaa537b6752ed3.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements 🌟[/h2]

[h3]Standardization of Assets[/h3]

With the latest update we're ensuring consistency across Stellarx on Meta and Stellarx on Steam by making all built-in assets and templates the same across versions. Spaces created on one platform will be fully compatible with the other, providing a seamless experience when switching devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/6aee613386720e5dc1e71d06550735403e0b42a7.png[/img]

[h3]International Servers [/h3]

We have deployed multiplayer servers in the European region to improve performance and reduce latency for players using multiplayer sessions in this area.

[h3]Space Sizes Transparency[/h3]

Space sizes are now more transparent. They now include the total size of all cloud assets, ensuring consistency across downloading, uploading, and saving. Previously, space sizes could vary between these actions, but this update provides a uniform measurement.

The space size is always available in the Space information Panel in the basecamp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/5e95b4ec6833c703186018ca1702c6b1941ed6d4.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes 🐞[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Avatar Recorder[/b] - Fixed issue where the avatar kept restarting its animation whenever buttons were toggled in the remix panel.
[*] [b]Color Widget[/b] - Resolved issue where closing the panel while holding the brightness bar caused the color widget to break.
[*] [b]Nodes[/b] - Fixed bug where the Equal Node did not work when the target input value was directly typed in.
[*] [b]Performance[/b] - Optimized project loading times for spaces opened from My Spaces.
[*] [b]Performance Profiler[/b] - Corrected incorrect Android geometry limit display
[/list]
❄️ Thank you for being part of our journey to improve StellarX! Your support keeps us moving forward. Wishing you a season of warmth and excitement!


Cheers,

The StellarX Crew ✨

notes.title: New Release — Transparency & Teleport Access
notes.notes:
Hello there, 👋🏻

As the leaves change colors and fall settles in, the StellarX team is buzzing with excitement to roll out a wave of new updates that bring fresh features, and several enhancements.


[h3]New Features 💫[/h3]

[b]Transparency for imported / cloud assets[/b]

Transparent textures will now be supported across all imported and cloud assets, enhancing the realism of your environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/b8494f563708f707fac7c69f8c0db21afa46007e.gif[/img]

[b]Teleport Access[/b]

We've added a feature to allow or prevent teleporting onto specific assets, making navigation smoother and more intuitive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/fca732f712924f3bac8260ec0b6ecacf55ae71f2.png[/img]

To control which assets can be teleported onto, use the toggle found in the asset remixes. All asset remixes, except those with custom colliders, now feature a teleport access toggle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/f35892cd7e82e2c6f6e881f526ab6c1738a19704.gif[/img]

[h3]Improvements 🌟[/h3]

[b]Media Panel[/b]

Our Design team has revised the Media Panel UI, and we're excited to bring those changes to you! The updates include adjustments to colors, spacing, icons, and component sizes for a more polished and user-friendly experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/8fa44f4655104ef675fc8b1a9bd7ef89add05662.gif[/img]

[b]Learning Analytics[/b]

Verbs displayed in the user's LRS have been revamped for a clearer and more simple format creating easy to read sentences. Here are a few example sentences made with different tracked Nodes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/f5a1cb7052283ba62dd75d33220af8ba1780597f.png[/img]

[b]Space Upload[/b]

To pave the way for exciting new features, we’ve streamlined the space-sharing process. We’ve now made a clear distinction between uploading a space to the cloud and generating a code to share it. 

[b]Media Deck Replication[/b] 

Collaborating users can now see all actions mirrored on the Media Panel in real time. Replication ensures that everyone interacting with Media experiences the same content simultaneously, keeping everything perfectly in sync.

[b]Manage Storage Access[/b]

The Manage Storage section displays Spaces that have been imported to the cloud.

With cloud importation being a pro-only feature, this section was previously only visible to pro users. It is now visible to all users, ensuring they don't lose access to their Spaces if their license expires.

To keep everything running smoothly, messages provide users with clear guidance and context. These messages are displayed in the top-right corner of the Manage Storage section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/5b211f3aa9a2a369737f1326e811a30dc09f8ac7.png[/img]

[b]Imported Media Formats[/b]

The following imported media formats are now supported on all platforms: 
[list]
[*] Supported audio formats: MP3, WAVE, WAV, OGG, AIFF, AIF, MOD and XM.
[*] Supported video formats: MP4, MOV, WEBM, M4V and VP8.
[/list]
[b]Exiting Complex Spaces [/b]

We've significantly reduced the time it takes to return to the lobby after exiting complex Spaces, making workflows faster and much smoother.

[h3]Bug fixes 🐞[/h3]

[list]
[*] Performance Issue on Login Screen: Fixed performance issue when reaching the login screen if microphone permissions are off on Android.
[*] Leave App Event in VR: Fixed issue where clicking on "Leaving StellarX" called the Leave App Event twice in Production.
[*] ColorWheel "Bug" Zone: Fixed issue where a "Bug" zone in the ColorWheel changed the color when clicking outside the wheel.
[*] Learning Analytics - SCORM Statement Order: Fixed issue where statements were logged in the wrong order on SCORM.
[*] Learning Analytics - Max Score Display: Fixed issue where a raw value was displayed on SCORM instead of 100% when a score value matched the maximum score in a Record node.
[*] UI Save Prompt: Fixed issue where the Save Prompt appears even when no changes were made in the space.
[*] Multi Media Player Exception: Fixed issue where a KeyNotFoundException occurred if a user left the space while the media player was playing media.
[*] VR Keyboard Text Erasure: Fixed issue where holding the delete button and closing the VR keyboard caused text input fields to be erased each time the VR keyboard was reopened.
[*] Color Widget VR Keyboard Distance: Fixed issue where the Color Widget VR keyboard was too far from the user.
[*] Remix Panel State: Fixed issue where the Remix panel remained open if another player undid/redid path points.
[*] Microphone Permissions Popup: Fixed issue where microphone permissions popped up twice when unchecking the Save preference and selecting "Don't allow."
[*] Black Screen on Sleep Mode Activation: Fixed issue where a black screen appeared when activating Sleep mode while opening StellarX for the first time.
[*] Color Widget Usability: Fixed issue where the Color Widget was unusable depending on the angle.
[*] Remix Panel Changes: Fixed issue where changes made in the Remix panel opened via a reference node were not registering.
[*] Basecamp Button Sound Effects: Fixed issue where some Basecamp buttons did not produce the correct sound effect when pressed.
[*] Bounding Box Trigger: Fixed issue where the bounding box was not triggered when pointing at certain areas of the Media Panel.
[*] Lock/Unlock: Fixed issue where an asset was stuck in a locked state when pointing and hand grabbing at the same time.
[*] Media Panel: Fixed issue where an asset was locked in Create mode when grabbed using left click in Preview mode.
[*] Particles: Fixed issue where pause and resume behavior was inconsistent between solo and multi modes.
[*] Bounding Box Color: Fixed issue where a locked asset’s bounding box turned blue instead of red when hovering with the hand.
[*] BaseCamp: Fixed issue where Avatars had their heads cut off in previews made in Create multi mode.
[*] MultiCreate - Lock/Unlock: Fixed issue where the bounding box color did not update properly when changing the lock state while pointing at the asset.
[*] Avatar Recorder: Fixed issue where animation restarted if the sound was longer when pausing and playing in Preview mode.
[*] Grab: Fixed issue where the hand rotation panel remained open if the user left the Space and returned, and the toggle was not reset by default.
[*] MultiCreate - Avatar Recorder: Fixed issue where the Avatar Recorder had no synchronization with the animation in Preview mode.
[*] Color Widget: Fixed issue where the color wheel was not correctly set the first time the color widget was opened.
[*] Canvas: Fixed issue where undoing while holding the minigraph and then trying to change canvas settings or name broke StellarX.
[*] Spaces: Fixed issue where assets that should be grabbable in templates were not.
[*] Media Panel: Fixed issue where the skip10 button on the media panel paused videos but not audio.
[*] Media Panel: Fixed issue where an asset kept the "Add media" position when switching to preview mode without closing collections.
[*] Basecamp: Fixed issue where the "Create Spaces" message did not appear when there were no Spaces in the "My Spaces" section.
[*] Avatar Recorder: Fixed issue where the audio preview broke if no animation was added.
[*] Preview - Asset Position Reset: Fixed issue where asset positions were not correctly reset when returning from preview mode a second time.
[*] Templates: Fixed issue where Airdock assets with custom colliders were not correctly updated.
[*] Space Sharing: Fixed issue where uploading only to the cloud caused issues with locally imported assets.
[*] Nodes: Fixed issue where snapping an asset to an interactive node did not make it behave as the interactive.
[/list]


Thank you for being part of our journey as we work to make StellarX even more enjoyable! Your feedback and support inspire us to keep pushing boundaries. As the air turns crisp, we hope you're enjoying a wonderful fall season! 🍂✨

Cheers,


The StellarX Crew ✨

notes.title: New Release — Usability Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello there, 👋🏻

As summer gets into full swing, the StellarX team is excited to bring you a host of improvements!


[h3]Improvements 💫[/h3]

[b]Avatar Recorder[/b]

The avatar recorder’s remix panel has been improved to make it even easier to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/0ac7d5fc116ca860763039b7ea11ac8163d660d1.png[/img]
 
We are also pleased to announce that the Avatar recorder is now also available in Multiplayer Create sessions!

[b]Grab Interaction [/b]

In VR, we enabled users to be able to grab assets with their virtual hand in addition to the pointer tip of the controller that was previously the default. This will ease the process of manipulating assets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/88b45dc8731b837bdb53736b5ec058fee90ec0e3.gif[/img]

[b]Dynamic Node Refresh [/b]

With the node refresh, when a value is changed, either manually (by remixing nodes) or by connecting value nodes to the scenario, the nodes will automatically display the new value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/91846a96509c52424587cb1649008fa93075bf0f.gif[/img]

[b]Better Node Visibility[/b]

We added a blue border around tracked nodes to have a better contrast of which nodes are tracked or not. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/ddd18cfed1a41602fb74a380d3ab957ecc5c3768.png[/img]

Removed the Socket to the Gate Node: Default State field. 

After many thoughts, it didn't make sense to be able to change the default state of a gate node during the execution of a scenario. As a result, the socket linked directly to the default state was deleted. However, the default state can still be modified in the remix before starting the scenario. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/5643843adfa46d775da0ace043b2b19ffa6cbd42.jpg[/img]

 
[h3]Bug fixes 🐞[/h3]

[list]
[*] UI arrow collision: Fixed issue where UI arrow was colliding with other assets.
[*] Path point deletion: Fixed issue where the user was unable to delete path points by clicking the (-) minus sign button.
[*] Media Panel UI: Fixed issue where the Media Panel UI was broken when using toggles.
[*] Canvas name length: Fixed issue where the 30-character limit on canvas names created problems for old scenarios with names longer than 30 characters.
[*] String variable node: Fixed issue where the string variable node did not work with events and triggers.
[*] VR keyboard URL input: Fixed issue where the VR keyboard field restricted input of lengthy URLs.
[*] VR blue square: Fixed issue where a blue square followed the user's base in VR.
[*] Black screen in preview mode: Fixed issue where a black screen appears when entering preview mode after undoing a create path point action.
[*] Bandwidth Limit Message: Fixed issue where an incorrect message was displayed when a user downloaded a space beyond the bandwidth limit.
[*] Lock State Retention: Fixed issue where the Media Panel and Avatar's remix panel did not retain their lock state.
[*] Numeric Field Selection: Fixed issue where selecting a numeric field from the Color widget without closing the virtual keyboard first caused the previous keyboard value to be entered into the newly selected input field.
[*] Black Screen on Login: Fixed issue where users were stuck on a black screen if permissions text appeared in the login environment.
[*] Physics Undo: Fixed issue where undoing the physics of an asset caused it to remain physical in preview until the physics were modified again.
[*] Path Point Undo: Fixed issue where undoing a path point before hovering did not move the point.
[*] Basecamp UI on Android: Fixed issue where the Basecamp UI broke if a user opened a space not compatible with Android.
[/list]

Thank you for being a part of our journey as we work to make StellarX even more enjoyable! Your feedback and support inspire us to keep pushing boundaries. We hope you’re having a fantastic summer! 🌟

Cheers,


The StellarX Crew ✨

notes.title: Major Release — Learning Analytics
notes.notes:
Hello there, 👋🏻

To kick off summer in style, the StellarX team is back with plenty of new features and improvements that will help you keep your experiences clear and tidy. 🧼


[h3]New Features 💫[/h3]

[b]Learning Analytics[/b]

An exciting new feature is the implementation of Learning Analytics. This is an essential tool to keep track of an XR learning experience’s success, so we thought it’d be time to implement it right into StellarX.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/121cb43c670d64fa6506bc779692eaeec21fcad3.gif[/img]

3 types of users will be able to benefit from this feature:
[list]
[*] The Creator can track and untrack nodes through the Radial Menu (PRO license only), and use and place the Record Score node.
[*] The Instructor can set up an LRS, retrieve their LRS endpoint credentials, provide a learner with credentials, and see statements in the LRS dashboard.
[*] The learner can link their account to the LRS via the Web Portal, experience the Space shared by the Creator, and automatically send statements based on tracked nodes to the Instructor’s LRS.
[/list]
[b]Asset Renaming[/b]

No more confusion while programming scenarios inside the canvas, and trying to discern between a bunch of assets with generic names. You can now open your remix panel, and rename assets. Simple as that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/da193656e7d75949ad039c9b4784d03d5f96cdba.png[/img]

Special assets, such as Particles and Paths, will display a special field for the renaming, while Canvases can be renamed directly from the title.


[b]Variable Node[/b]

A new type of Node is now available to all users :  the Variable Node.

Our Canvas platform is designed to make creating XR experiences accessible to everyone, even those without any programming experience. In line with this, we are now incorporating variables. This programming concept improves readability and reduces complexity by allowing you to use values across different canvases without needing to link a single node repeatedly, which can often become confusing.

Variable Nodes can be renamed to better represent the values they contain, making your workflow more intuitive. They are also available for Numeric, Text and Boolean values.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/35f3f5e932dda40066aeed8442ca6a793d6444f0.png[/img]


[b]Unset Tool[/b]

Previously, the Set as Tool node could not be disabled during a play session. With the introduction of the new Unset Tool node, any asset designated as a tool can now be disabled and become a regular asset once this node is added to the flow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/bb96fe15146f5fb7dd010028cb0219bd1931556b.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements 👍🏾[/h3]

[b]Asset Hub improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Users can now see new assets they’ve added via the Asset Hub without needing to reboot StellarX.
[*] We’ve added a new syncing state for both My Models, and My Media.
[*] Users will be shown a notification whenever new assets are available for use, whether it be Models or Medias.
[/list]
[b]Other improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The loading screen now shows an image instead of a black screen for better feedback that the app is working.
[*] Dynamic fields are now displayed after the selection of an Audio in the Avatar Recorder: Spatialize, Range, and Play on Record, which lets the user control the feature better.
[*] SteamVR no longer opens when launching StellarX in Desktop Mode.
[*] The Play Media Node now has an On Finish Flow Out, allowing users to connect the node to another interaction. For example, they can now have a helicopter take flight after a video finishes playing.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes 🐞[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where links from Interactives value outputs to a set value were deleted when space was updated to 140.
[*] Resolved problem where the Audio/Spatial Data prompt failed to reappear after installing STX, unchecking "Save preferences," clicking "Allow," enabling audio, and rebooting STX.
[*] Corrected issue that caused users to get stuck on the Preparing Assets screen when trying to download a space containing cloud assets onto a device without those assets.
[*] Addressed game-breaking issues when opening a space made from the Hello Desert template.
[*] Fixed bug allowing users to teleport and activate controllers during the black screen transition between login and basecamp.
[*] Resolved issue with the Transform box tool on Android.
[*] Fixed problem where downloading an asset from the hub made it impossible to get to StellarX basecamp.
[*] Corrected issue where downloading spaces with the same media's name resulted in media from the first space playing when opening the second space.
[*] Resolved missing reference exception caused by using an asset reference in a scenario when returning to basecamp.
[*] Addressed desync issue between Space and Scenario version when downloading a Space from the Cloud with compatibility failure.
[*] Fixed issue where the duration of transform nodes applied differently to translation vs rotation.
[*] Corrected game-breaking issue caused by adding a path point while another player is redoing another path point.
[*] Resolved problem with importation hub assets still downloading even if the user had reached basecamp.
[*] Fixed issue where Avatar recorder audio could be seen at coordinates 0,0.
[*] Addressed significant FPS drop when adding more than 10 avatars in a scene.
[*] Corrected issue where the media file remained unassigned when selecting the reference avatar on the Stop Media Node.
[*] Fixed problem causing users to get stuck in the preparing asset screen when downloading a space from a previous version on Android.
[*] Resolved game-breaking issues caused by having a space in My Spaces and Shared Spaces with the same name.
[*] Fixed issue where media nodes' "media file" section was not updated with changes made in the space.
[*] Corrected error occurring when downloading two spaces with the same name that the user doesn't own.
[*] Addressed issue preventing Meta users from joining a multiplayer session.
[*] Fixed null reference error when attempting to assign audio sources to the media panel after undoing creation.
[*] Corrected visibility of Asset ID for audios in Pause Media Node and Stop Media Node.
[*] Resolved issue where the same audio could not be selected twice in the Avatar recorder.
[*] Fixed unexpected changes in Avatar recorder remix.
[*] Corrected issue where the avatar was detached from its pad when pressing Record.
[*] Addressed multiple null reference errors after logging in on PCVR when cloud assets were downloaded.
[*] Fixed issue where imported audiospheres couldn't be paused or stopped.
[*] Corrected issue where the avatar body was not centered with the library in audio selection after recording an animation.
[/list]

As always, we’re doing our best to make StellarX the most user-friendly we can. We are super thankful for your continued support, and will continue improving these new features in the near future. 🚀🌟
 

Cheers,

- The StellarX Crew  ✨

notes.title: Major Release — Sketchfab Importer
notes.notes:
Hello there, 👋🏻

We’re back with something exciting for StellarX: version 2.0.0 of the web portal! 🥳 


[h3]New Features 💫[/h3]

[b]The Sketchfab Importer ⬇️[/b]

With this new feature, StellarX users will be able to search and import 3D models from the Sketchfab store, right into their Asset Hub — without ever leaving the Web Portal page. 

To do so, just follow the following steps:

[olist]
[*] Log in to the StellarX web portal 
[*] Go to the ‘My asset’ section
[*] Click on ‘+’ 
[*] Select Sketchfab
[*] Log in to Sketchfab
[*] Search for the 3D model you wish to include in your StellarX spaces 
[*] Select the 3D model
[*] Click on ‘Import’
[/olist]
Voilà! The 3D model is now uploaded, and downloadable inside your StellarX collections!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/4fd9d323b9a69d7f4560e98fc6e2a36a2b417c5f.png[/img]
Please note that this feature currently has a few limitations:

[list]
[*] Available only for free downloadable models
[*] Available only for files in gLTF format
[*] Maximum of 50 download requests per 24 hour period
[*] 10MB maximum file size for importation
[*] Requires a Sketchfab account
[/list]

notes.title: New Release — Performance optimization
notes.notes:
Hello there, 👋🏻

Dive into optimization and efficiency with our latest release, featuring the addition of our performance profiling tool, designed to empower you with insights into your system's efficiency and speed.🚀


[b]New Features 💫[/b]

Introducing the Performance Profiling Tool

Our Performance Profiling Tool offers a comprehensive suite of features tailored to provide deep insights into your application's performance metrics. With an integrated FPS meter, you gain real-time visibility into frame rate performance, enabling you to identify and address any bottlenecks that may impact user experience. Additionally, the tool's geometry count functionality allows you to precisely monitor the complexity of your application's graphics rendering, ensuring optimal resource allocation and efficient rendering pipelines. Furthermore, detailed memory usage analysis empowers you to track and manage memory consumption, allowing for efficient memory utilization and proactive optimization to enhance overall application stability and performance.

You can easily access it by opening the Shortcut Menu and selecting the Performance Profiler option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/18211adcfdbefd121c2f8945821241e0ed4747ac.png[/img]

[b]Improvements 👍🏾[/b]

Big rework of the Avatar Recorder

As a beta feature, the Avatar Recorder is undergoing significant evolution. Due to an unforeseen shift in the underlying technology, we've overhauled the entire animation system. While this revamp has enabled us to greatly expand its capabilities, it also renders all previous Avatar Recorder versions obsolete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/5309c2d5689495b550c2f4517245d1d398821bca.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Avatar Recorders retained the possibility to record an animation following your own movements.
[*] We've streamlined the lip-sync functionality by introducing the option to directly bind audio to the recorder, enhancing ease of use and efficiency.
[*] Stay tuned for many more forthcoming changes!
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes 🐞[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer Create: Fixed issue where remixing any asset and locking/unlocking it before moving would reset its position.
[*] Multiplayer Create: Addressed bug causing caret to move incorrectly in remix fields with refresh.
[*] Multiplayer Create: Users can now connect to multi-server without getting stuck in a black screen.
[*] Multiplayer Create: Resolved crash occurring when creating a session is called simultaneously.
[*] Media Panel: Fixed issue causing VR keyboard to close media selection and thus, making the Avatar Recorder stuck in its media selection state.
[*] Media Panel: Corrected media file playback when added on top of another media.
[*] Media Panel: Prevented audio sphere from spawning in space after adding media to the panel and then leaving and returning to the Space.
[*] Glow: Adjusted glow effect to only apply to emissive parts of imported and cloud assets.
[*] Importation Hub: Resolved duplication of zip assets in the collection.
[*] Asset Hub: Fixed issue preventing Spaces with cloud assets added by another user from opening.
[*] Lock/Unlock: Assets included in scenarios with animations will no longer be locked after preview.
[*] Undo/Redo: Fixed broken commands when an asset is destroyed by a tool.
[*] UI: Radial menu and remix options are now disabled during "Black screen" save prompt.
[*] UI: Users can now move assets without closing the remix panel.
[*] Avatar Recorder: Animations recorded on one platform can now be played on another.
[*] Basecamp: Fixed error caused by spamming "create new space" button.
[*] Basecamp: Fixed an issue with the size of a Space that wasn't getting updated correctly after changes.
[*] Basecamp: Black screen issue resolved when attempting to re-enter space with cloud assets from Basecamp while you have no internet connection.
[*] Basecamp: Fixed black screen when opening shared space in create or play while you have no internet connection.
[*] Basecamp: Templates with scenarios now display correct size upon creation.
[*] Basecamp: StellarX now opens with correct section when no spaces are present.
[*] VoIP: Addressed crash causing voice IP to stop working after a while.
[/list]
Stay tuned for more updates!


Cheers,

- The StellarX Crew  ✨

notes.title: Major Release — Asset Hub
notes.notes:
Hello there, 👋🏻

After a summer of dedication and innovation, we're thrilled to introduce our next major feature to StellarX 🌞🚀


[b]Asset Hub💫[/b]

IIntroducing the Asset Hub! Within the StellarX Web Portal, you can now effortlessly import your personal assets. From music and sounds to videos and 3D assets, you can upload them and they'll be instantly available for you to use within StellarX. he best part? Your imagination is the limit as you breathe life into your spaces using assets that make your Space uniquely yours. It's time to turn your visions into reality! 🚀🎨

To make this feature accessible to all users (even those of you without a license), we're offering up to 500MB of free storage. This gives you plenty of room to liven up your Space and make your Scenarios more realistic. Time to get building!🌟📦


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/bd2fb534bf4effb910d1b080b4109f4f59392a99.png[/img]

Here's how to use it:

[list]
[*] Login into your StellarX Dashboard on the Web. You'll see the Asset Hub panel now on the left. Drag and drop your assets into the Hub
[*] Login into StellarX and open your preferred Space
[*] Access your Collections by pressing the Collections button located on your Control Panel
[*] Look for "My Models" and "My Medias" packs and download your assets!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36506504/33f5c2f19428c6e67734dd3c8c6c4c150f93f5bf.gif[/img]

[b]Updates👍🏾[/b]
[list]
[*] Particles are now fully available in Multiplayer Create Mode, allowing you to create, remix and experiment Particles with your friends and colleagues, adding a new dimension to your collaborative experiences.
[*] We've improved the handling of Avatar Recorders with the Play Animation node's On Finish flow output, ensuring more seamless scenarios.
[*] Get a grip on immersion with the added ability to detect avatar hands in Trigger Zones.
[*] For Voice Assist newcomers, there's now a quick tutorial to help you get started with this feature.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes 🐞[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved a critical issue where launching StellarX on Quest 3 failed to trigger Spatial permissions, rendering the app unlaunchable.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the rotation of rotative mechanisms in Hangar and Airdock templates.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Voice Assist and Library panels to overlap.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented assets with a size just below 10Mb from loading on the Quest.
[*] Fixed an issue in Desktop mode where holding an asset and pressing Shift would push the asset forward in the Space.
[/list]

With these exciting updates, StellarX is more versatile, creative, and user-friendly than ever before. Your creative journey begins now, so dive in and craft your digital universe! Thank you for joining us on this stellar adventure. 🚀🌟🎨


Cheers,

- The StellarX Crew  ✨
